name: Territory Rewards
summary: Territory rewards give cash and XP when you capture or defend a flag.
role: Stay in the flag area until the capture is complete. Continue to defend the flag to get more rewards.
fun_facts: A defense reward timer continues after the initial capture. A long defense can give multiple rewards.

name: Kill and Assist Rewards
summary: Kill and assist rewards give cash and XP when you damage or kill a Furry.
role: Damage an enemy to get an assist reward. Kill the enemy to get the full reward.
fun_facts: The rare kill reward roll is at ten percent.

name: Boss Rewards
summary: Boss rewards give cash and XP after the team defeats the boss. The reward amount depends on the damage that each player does.
role: Damage the boss to get a reward. A player who does more damage gets a larger reward.

stats.defeated_badge: Awarded to all players on boss defeat

fun_facts: The game gives the boss defeat badge to all players when the boss dies.

name: Daily Rewards
summary: Daily rewards give cash. A daily claim streak increases the reward. The Plus reward gives more cash.
role: Claim the reward each day to keep the streak.
fun_facts: Daily reward streak math uses a multiplier, not a flat repeated bonus.

name: Activity Rewards
summary: The activity reward gives XP after you play for 10 minutes.
role: Stay active for 10 minutes. You can get this reward one time each UTC day.
fun_facts: The activity reward timer is ten minutes or 600 seconds.

name: Group Rewards
summary: Group rewards give bonus XP and the M60 to members of the LQI ROBLOX group.
role: Join the LQI ROBLOX group to get these rewards.
fun_facts: M60 is the group reward weapon.

name: Referral Rewards
summary: Referral rewards give cash and XP to the player who sends an invite and the player who accepts it.
role: Send an invite to a new player. Both players get a reward after the new player joins.
fun_facts: The referral qualification delay is only ten seconds.
